Five comments

Wonderful reel from J.A. Hevia (terra di nadie), that I learnt in a minor with my bagpipes centre-france in G in a bagpipe stage in Belgium. I transposed it into c minor (not available,so I chose F dorian because I needed 3 b) for you, players of scottish pipes or for gaita in Bb players. Possible to play it in d minor (1b) if wou want to do it as hevia, you must have a midi bagpipes (or you’re the best piper of the world…).

↳ Posted by gaitazampogna_32 on May 12th, 2007.

Re-transcribed from “Lo Mejor de Hevia”

I’ve just published my transcription from the recent compilation “Lo Mejor de Hevia”.
The 2nd part is different from those earlier transcriptions already published.
Perhaps Hevia’s own version evolved over the years.

I give the “Irish compatible” version in Edor instead of Fdor.
